_comment: INVALID example — annotated with the specific violations for training/validation-test purposes. Remove _comment and _violations before using as a test fixture; they are not part of the schema (additionalProperties:false would reject them too).
_violations: working_memory.ttl is missing entirely, but working_memory is an ephemeral tier that requires ttl (violates schema required + Constitution §13.3 / VAL-076)
session_memory.ownership.tenant_id is null, violating tenant partitioning (violates Constitution §13.2 / VAL-073)
long_term_memory is missing retention_policy, but it is a durable tier that requires one (violates schema required + Constitution §13.3 / VAL-077)
semantic_memory.pii.contains_pii is true but erasure_cascade_required is false (violates DDD BR-109 / VAL-078)
vector_memory is missing embedding_model_version entirely (violates schema required + Architecture §20 / VAL-079)
access_gateway is an empty string, implying a direct store connection bypass (violates Architecture §20 mediation pattern / VAL-080)
pii_policy.contains_pii is true but erasure_cascade_required is missing (violates Constitution §13.5 / VAL-078)
description: Broken memory configuration used to demonstrate validation failures.
